known.via: English Wikipedia "Colli Euganei" (redirects to "Euganean Hills") (a wine place on Wikidata)

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

blurb.text: A Veneto denomination in the Euganean Hills, volcanic hills of 980 to 2,000 feet rising from the plain south of Padua. Its rules allow still and several sparkling styles.
